about.text: A curd cheese with a yellow coating and a strong smell. The Hungarian article that lists it describes the Czech Olomouc Quargel, a lean soured-milk curd cheese ripened with a red smear, so it may be that cheese rather than a Hungarian one.

sources.text: The Olomouc cheese and its making, from the Kvargli article; the Olomouc link in the list of fresh cheeses.
